top_developments.headline: The great escape from Theni jail
top_developments.summary: On October 26, a group of 17 remand prisoners hatched a plan to escape from the Theni district jail under the cover of darkness. All of them were apprehended within 42 hours in a massive search operation involving various Tamil Nadu police teams and drones. But the jailbreak has raised larger questions about prison overcrowding, staff shortages, security, and the need for reform, reports L. Srikrishna

sections.government_and_administration: - **After Theni, another jailbreak in Tamil Nadu — this time in Coimbatore:** A robbery accused, who had escaped from Annur police station the previous evening before being recaptured, fled again while being admitted to Coimbatore prison. The breach comes days after 17 prisoners escaped from Theni jail, prompting a shake-up of the state prison administration. ([The Indian Express](https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/chennai/coimbatore-central-prison-jailbreak-theni-tamil-nadu-10944522/))
